message_ja: v0.3.59 は Quick Comms パネルの使い勝手の改善です。衛星選択とその記憶、「Others」項目、オスカー番号表示、Rig/Rotator 接続状態の色表示、SDR Control タブへの表示を追加しました。
message_en: Version 0.3.59 improves the Quick Comms panel: satellite selection is now remembered, an 'Others' entry, Oscar designators in the list, colour-coded Rig/Rotator connection buttons, and the panel is now shown on the SDR Control tab.
_comment: Bump latest_version on every release. Raise minimum_supported_version and set critical=true only when older versions genuinely misbehave and every user must update; otherwise keep critical=false. See docs/app-update.md.
